lines.text: 1. Confirm the folder contains `index.html`. Done when that file is present. If it is missing, use the built site (a comprehende `export` out dir).

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.summary: Add comprehende and pages skills to the PR workflow
lines.text: 2. Pick dest. A pull request they named, or `gh pr view --json number` when hosting that review, uses `--pr`. Anything else uses `--name` with a lowercase slug they named, or one you make. Done when you have exactly one of `--pr` or `--name`.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.summary: Make the pages skill self-contained
lines.text: 3. From the repo root, run `node --experimental-strip-types .agents/skills/pages/scripts/pages-review.ts publish --dir <folder>` with that dest. `--dir` may live outside the work tree. Other flags: append `--help`. Done when the command prints a URL.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.summary: fix(pages): keep a PR's evidence/ folder when republishing its review
lines.text: PR screenshots go in `evidence/` inside the folder you publish; link them from the PR body as `<url>evidence/<file>`. A republish to the same dest replaces everything except `evidence/`, so a refreshed review keeps them.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.summary: ci(pages): a merged pull request's review and evidence stay up for 30 days
lines.text: `node --experimental-strip-types .agents/skills/pages/scripts/pages-review.ts prune --pr <n>` removes one site; `prune --ttl-days 30` removes every site older than 30 days. `.github/workflows/pages-reviews.yml` runs the second daily, so a merged pull request's review and evidence stay up for 30 days after their last publish.
